meta.title: Illuminating Tomorrow - 2
meta.description: The flames which burn away all corruption light up the darkness before dawn.

units.rawText: Hesperus, what do you think wine would taste like?
units.displayText: Hesperus, what do you think wine would taste like?

spans.text: Hesperus, what do you think wine would taste like?

units.rawText: ...Wine?
units.displayText: ...Wine?

spans.text: ...Wine?

units.rawText: Yes, I hear it's a beverage our gods partake of when they feel happiness or melancholy.
units.displayText: Yes, I hear it's a beverage our gods partake of when they feel happiness or melancholy.

spans.text: Yes, I hear it's a beverage our gods partake of when they feel happiness or melancholy.

units.rawText: The drink Electra created before piqued my interest and I entertained the thought of having everyone taste of the real thing.
units.displayText: The drink Electra created before piqued my interest and I entertained the thought of having everyone taste of the real thing.

spans.text: The drink Electra created before piqued my interest and I entertained the thought of having everyone taste of the real thing.

units.rawText: If we ever did have the chance, I should love to sample its flavor.
units.displayText: If we ever did have the chance, I should love to sample its flavor.

spans.text: If we ever did have the chance, I should love to sample its flavor.

units.rawText: ...Very well. Before you return from Tartarus, I shall have this wine you speak of ready.
units.displayText: ...Very well. Before you return from Tartarus, I shall have this wine you speak of ready.

spans.text: ...Very well. Before you return from Tartarus, I shall have this wine you speak of ready.

units.rawText: Seeing the surprise on his face, Hesperus frowns with displeasure.
units.displayText: Seeing the surprise on his face, Hesperus frowns with displeasure.

spans.text: Seeing the surprise on his face, Hesperus frowns with displeasure.

units.rawText: What is it?
units.displayText: What is it?

spans.text: What is it?

units.rawText: Nothing, I am merely a little surprised. What you just said really is not your usual style... No, pay it no mind.
units.displayText: Nothing, I am merely a little surprised. What you just said really is not your usual style... No, pay it no mind.

spans.text: Nothing, I am merely a little surprised. What you just said really is not your usual style... No, pay it no mind.

units.rawText: Let's call it a deal, then.
units.displayText: Let's call it a deal, then.

spans.text: Let's call it a deal, then.

units.rawText: He smiles and accedes, moving on from the previous topic.
units.displayText: He smiles and accedes, moving on from the previous topic.

spans.text: He smiles and accedes, moving on from the previous topic.

units.rawText: It is indeed true that you are more suited to guarding the border.
units.displayText: It is indeed true that you are more suited to guarding the border.

spans.text: It is indeed true that you are more suited to guarding the border.

units.rawText: We have always delegated the work as such. You manage the safety and affairs of Magrasea and I guard Tartarus...
units.displayText: We have always delegated the work as such. You manage the safety and affairs of Magrasea and I guard Tartarus...

spans.text: We have always delegated the work as such. You manage the safety and affairs of Magrasea and I guard Tartarus...

units.rawText: What prompted these musings?
units.displayText: What prompted these musings?

spans.text: What prompted these musings?

units.rawText: I am only recognizing the gods' wisdom. The dragon, more suited to arms, shall be posted there, stifling any threat while it is still in its cradle.
units.displayText: I am only recognizing the gods' wisdom. The dragon, more suited to arms, shall be posted there, stifling any threat while it is still in its cradle.

spans.text: I am only recognizing the gods' wisdom. The dragon, more suited to arms, shall be posted there, stifling any threat while it is still in its cradle.

units.rawText: By the way, why did you choose a dragon as your symbol?
units.displayText: By the way, why did you choose a dragon as your symbol?

spans.text: By the way, why did you choose a dragon as your symbol?

units.rawText: You need not tell me if it is troublesome. I only ask out of my personal curiosity.
units.displayText: You need not tell me if it is troublesome. I only ask out of my personal curiosity.

spans.text: You need not tell me if it is troublesome. I only ask out of my personal curiosity.

units.rawText: Finding Hesperus silent, Eosphorus attempts to round out his awkward previous statement.
units.displayText: Finding Hesperus silent, Eosphorus attempts to round out his awkward previous statement.

spans.text: Finding Hesperus silent, Eosphorus attempts to round out his awkward previous statement.

units.rawText: ...I once heard a story about a dragon.
units.displayText: ...I once heard a story about a dragon.

spans.text: ...I once heard a story about a dragon.

units.rawText: Story?
units.displayText: Story?

spans.text: Story?

units.rawText: Yes. I don't remember the exact details, only that the dragon could not overcome destiny in the end, falling in its beloved land.
units.displayText: Yes. I don't remember the exact details, only that the dragon could not overcome destiny in the end, falling in its beloved land.

spans.text: Yes. I don't remember the exact details, only that the dragon could not overcome destiny in the end, falling in its beloved land.

units.rawText: But when it fell, it felt no regret.
units.displayText: But when it fell, it felt no regret.

spans.text: But when it fell, it felt no regret.

units.rawText: Its final roar echoed through a valley, carving this will into the heart of generation after generation of young dragons.
units.displayText: Its final roar echoed through a valley, carving this will into the heart of generation after generation of young dragons.

spans.text: Its final roar echoed through a valley, carving this will into the heart of generation after generation of young dragons.

units.rawText: Thus, it lived on as a flame of faith, eternally lighting the way ahead for its progeny.
units.displayText: Thus, it lived on as a flame of faith, eternally lighting the way ahead for its progeny.

spans.text: Thus, it lived on as a flame of faith, eternally lighting the way ahead for its progeny.

units.rawText: <color=orange>...I wish to become an existence like it one day.</color>
units.displayText: ...I wish to become an existence like it one day.

spans.text: ...I wish to become an existence like it one day.

units.rawText: The new overlord of Magrasea ends his reminiscence, gazing at the figure in his way who was burning away his life.
units.displayText: The new overlord of Magrasea ends his reminiscence, gazing at the figure in his way who was burning away his life.

spans.text: The new overlord of Magrasea ends his reminiscence, gazing at the figure in his way who was burning away his life.

units.rawText: His silhouette becomes blurry in the raging flames, only his shattered weapon supporting his figure discernible in the heat.
units.displayText: His silhouette becomes blurry in the raging flames, only his shattered weapon supporting his figure discernible in the heat.

spans.text: His silhouette becomes blurry in the raging flames, only his shattered weapon supporting his figure discernible in the heat.

units.rawText: <color=orange>The dragon shall not go out with but a wail...</color>
units.displayText: The dragon shall not go out with but a wail...

spans.text: The dragon shall not go out with but a wail...

units.rawText: He fixates upon the shattered blade for some time, before finally walking past it.
units.displayText: He fixates upon the shattered blade for some time, before finally walking past it.

spans.text: He fixates upon the shattered blade for some time, before finally walking past it.

units.rawText: Kyaak—
units.displayText: Kyaak—

spans.text: Kyaak—

units.rawText: Away with you.
units.displayText: Away with you.

spans.text: Away with you.

units.rawText: An unsheathed blade of starlight slays a monster that dared approach in a single strike.
units.displayText: An unsheathed blade of starlight slays a monster that dared approach in a single strike.

spans.text: An unsheathed blade of starlight slays a monster that dared approach in a single strike.

units.rawText: Therein lies an existence you shan't be allowed to taint.
units.displayText: Therein lies an existence you shan't be allowed to taint.

spans.text: Therein lies an existence you shan't be allowed to taint.

units.rawText: He speaks no more, only looking up at the endless blazing wall before him.
units.displayText: He speaks no more, only looking up at the endless blazing wall before him.

spans.text: He speaks no more, only looking up at the endless blazing wall before him.

units.rawText: Even after its master's passing, the fierce flames still burn away the Entropics, halting their advance.
units.displayText: Even after its master's passing, the fierce flames still burn away the Entropics, halting their advance.

spans.text: Even after its master's passing, the fierce flames still burn away the Entropics, halting their advance.

units.rawText: Eosphorus knew that these warding flames, fueled by a neural cloud would not fade easily. Even if he were to attack it with all his might, it would take some time to break through.
units.displayText: Eosphorus knew that these warding flames, fueled by a neural cloud would not fade easily. Even if he were to attack it with all his might, it would take some time to break through.

spans.text: Eosphorus knew that these warding flames, fueled by a neural cloud would not fade easily. Even if he were to attack it with all his might, it would take some time to break through.

units.rawText: He had no such designs, however.
units.displayText: He had no such designs, however.

spans.text: He had no such designs, however.

units.rawText: He only wished to watch this flame burn until its final moments.
units.displayText: He only wished to watch this flame burn until its final moments.

spans.text: He only wished to watch this flame burn until its final moments.
